source: A grid may contain far more blocks than can be resident simultaneously. That is normal. The grid describes the logical work. The ZXNAME0000XZ admits blocks as ZXNAME0001XZ resources become available, executes them, and admits more blocks later. An ordinary block is placed on one ZXNAME0002XZ for its lifetime; multiple blocks may be resident on one ZXNAME0003XZ if resource limits allow.[1,2]
zh: 一个网格包含的块数可能远远多于同时驻留的块数。这是正常的。网格描述了逻辑工作。当 ZXNAME0001XZ 资源变得可用时，ZXNAME0000XZ 接纳块，执行它们，并稍后接纳更多块。一个普通块在其生命周期内被放置在一个 ZXNAME0002XZ 上；如果资源限制允许，多个块可以驻留在一个 ZXNAME0003XZ 上。[1,2]
